notes.title: Join the Hairvolution with Hairdresser Simulator Release on Q4 2023!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Stylists![/h3]

We've been away for a hot minute, but guess what? We're back in action, and boy, do we have some serious news to share! Drumroll, please… Prepare for today’s dev update that will shed a new light on our content.

[h3][b]Trailer[/b][/h3]
I couldn't have kicked things off on a stronger note today.! Let me break it down for you. We've just released the latest Hairdresser Simulator trailer. Don't miss out on all the exciting hair-styling action. Get a sneak peek now!

[previewyoutube=En6ntADcCTM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Release Date[/b][/h3]

Okay, Stylists, get ready to buckle up for another thrilling news! [b]Premiere of the Hairdresser Simulator is scheduled for Q4 of this year![/b] So mark your calendars because this is an experience you won't want to let slip away!

[h3][b]Closed Beta[/b][/h3]

Brace yourself, as Hairdresser's Closed Beta is just around the corner, granting a select group of YouTubers and streamers the chance to unleash a whole new level of content. So, keep your eyes peeled and your fingers crossed because you might stumble upon a treasure trove of exciting footage in no time!

[h3][b]Character Creator[/b][/h3]

In Hairdresser Simulator you will encounter to two types of customers with different demands. Meet specific hairdo requirements for one group, while the other lets you unleash your creativity. Customize characters with awesome hair, facial features, and outfits. But hold on tight! Here's the cool part: you can upload a photo to create your very own character! Try funky hair colors or experiment with celeb looks. It's your secret world, unless you feel like sharing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/1cf6fa8337527371979880644493497025aa8fe8.gif[/img]

Get ready to explore new perspectives and take your salon expertise to the next level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/2971f4cfb42dd66f965b7dc6095359870da8a117.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Make a schedule[/b][/h3]

Hey, wanna get your salon game on point? Well, here's the deal: you gotta plan your schedule, book appointments and stick to them. Trust me, without a proper order, your hair will be standing on end! So, let's get organized and make sure those locks are slaying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/3ad24d92d32b95731ad3f21264c8b24a2ecb58e8.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New models[/b][/h3]

We're bringing a whole new flavor to our game with a bunch of different characters and hair models. A wider range of hairstyles will allow you to put your skills to the test by experimenting with diverse hair types. Level up your abilities and pave the way for your dream career.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/2a08eca649f41cf1e40106ce1cc709aba499f229.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Keep up to date[/b][/h3]

That's a wrap, stylists! Just a reminder, the scheduled [b]release date is Q4 2023[/b]. Check out the Hairdresser Simulator Steam Page, and follow our social media for the latest updates and news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330560/Hairdresser_Simulator/ 

We hope you had a blast with this little showcase, and we'll catch you in the upcoming shows!

Wishing you a Hairtastic day ahead!

[i]Petard Games, and Frozen Way teams~[/i]

notes.title: Development update #4 - It's time for your own hairdresser salon!
notes.content:
[b]Hello there, Stylists💈[/b]


Not so long ago, we promised you that we didn’t stop developing our game. That’s why, today, we’re back, much quicker than last time, with a new dev log! 
As always, I’d love to thank you for your honest opinion on the last news. It’s much appreciated that you look forward to the game!

Today we'll go through a few features – new improved behavior (and animations) of our customers, expansion of hair mechanics, and a little surprise at the end, so be sure to read till the end not to miss it 😉

[h3][b]New Poster[/b][/h3]

It’s poster time – we’re introducing more and more human factors to the game, so it was high time to change our header. Now you can see a hairdresser at work, which is the meat and potatoes of our gameplay. We'd love to know how you compare it to the previous one, so please share your thoughts in the comments section below.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/490f6474554411fbaf447b49b31fae40d72ce3ff.png[/img][/list]

[h3][b]Facial expressions[/b][/h3]

Our goal is to make it feel like you work with real human beings. Thanks to the new facial expressions, the game is more immersive than before.
Now you can see how your client reacts to your actions. A customer might wink at you, smile, look in your direction, and will probably close his eyes during the hair-washing and drying process… Unless he thinks he might enjoy getting shampooed in the eye.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/b66080eccc22b6b0bca2dd100213fb6a6b852bdd.gif[/img][/list]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/dfa851df7341a516acf7cfc5481fa218e59496d9.gif[/img][/list]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/3a62dbe42cac9650136708d843f1bcef9310e485.gif[/img][/list]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/b1304d3daa8354ed8a30206f406380488af952d4.gif[/img][/list]

[h3][b]Mechanics[/b][/h3]

Feel comfortable at work with the new hairdresser sink that you can use for head washing – along with shampooing and rinsing dyes off.
Let’s straighten every inch of hair with the new straightener. We changed how it looks and improved the animation.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/6130f44a7b5d4d5e30dded1424fe2e6a4908425c.gif[/img][/list]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/fed98cd00c882ae7217dda23c5b2a9800bf9c251.gif[/img][/list]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/9b1d3433cd8ed2d44ae355732b6ceecab739b087.gif[/img][/list]

[h3][b]Hair trimmer[/b][/h3]

And now something new – you can join our salon and adjust your hairstyle as you wish. We would like to present the hair trimmer – the primary accomplice to dramatic transformation and cool fades… If one knows how to use it. Be careful of the power you wield!
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/a9c720e19057646306dc7c29d0e65523a5492ae0.gif[/img][/list]

[h3][b]Making the salon[/b][/h3]

Now’s the time for the promised surprise. Believe me or not, it’s not a piece of cake to run your own hairdressing salon. Let me take you through some basics step by step.

First of all let’s choose the logo and a name.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/1a543c51b96ce7b86159718f7ad9bdccc18a2e90.gif[/img][/list]

Then it’s time to take out the trash. We want to clear out space for new furniture.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/3692d953a6daa0e343af0aed99475c2dcdd7d255.gif[/img][/list]

Let’s make it shiny as new by plugging holes in the walls. It’s crucial to get the salon ready before customers' arrival.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/a4eca0dd57f99f2d1f8fde267eb904ef9bacf2fe.gif[/img][/list]

Sell equipment left over by previous owners and start a new life for your business.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/be6bbf22c16a726b2c32c4ed13b7de49dc167735.gif[/img][/list]

What’s left is to buy the most important accessories and finish the renovation.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/99ef225c8c3319a179a66272d8623baa106c8efd.gif[/img][/list]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/21c9cf734f5acdd742982fe1cc320a30570cf08c.gif[/img][/list]

Now you’re ready to face upcoming challenges and begin your climb to the top of the ladder – become the best hairdresser in town!

[h3][b]Keep up to date[/b][/h3]

That would be it for today’s development update, Stylists. I hope you liked our little showcase and found something that interests you. It’s another big step for us, so we’d be thrilled to know what you found to be the most exciting part of our update. Please let us know in the comments section below.

As always, we recommend following our social media channels for future updates and wishlist us on Steam to don’t miss the next devlogs.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330560/Hairdresser_Simulator/ 

Frozen Way & Petard Games teams~

notes.title: Hairdresser Simulator Dev Update #2 – Cut it out! We’re HAIRing!
notes.content:
Hello there, Hairdressers!

It’s been a long time, but our developers haven’t stopped! We’re aware of your interest in the game, that’s why we’ve got some cool work-in-progress graphics!
Before we proceed, we’d like to thank you for your activity on our social media and steam page. We’re grateful for the feedback and every opinion.

So, without further ado, let’s get scissors in hand, and cut some hair!

First of all, before the mechanics and animations, We'd like to show you how our work looks now, especially hair model.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/a47c52e45a2bb37149b7a4cf2b977d156195a31b.png[/img]

The first news from our hairdressing saloon is the pie menu, where you can pick previously bought scissors. You could spot that waving hair, but that will come later.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/bba3814e69b14d63b2c0a9d9f3d792055502c5b0.gif[/img][/list]

Our team is constantly working on improving our hair mechanics and physics. We've also added cutting animation, so you can see what the early work in progress looks like. They wave, move, and are flexible in your hand, but it’s still a way to perfection. Every opinion would be an asset, and we’re looking forward to it.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/747dfd5943654c8065ea83bd5a20c43c3894eaa1.gif[/img][/list]

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/326efad2924a661f375f57048af69d1f7f9892ce.gif[/img][/list]

And last but not least is that wavy move. Flexibility and realistic physics are WIP, but we’ve decided to share that with you.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/0c5eb8210b08f6e48bc4fb075b90b62f8149f777.gif[/img][/list]

So, that would be it for today's development update. We hope that you’ve liked our little showcase. We know it’s not much, but it’s honest work, so prepare for future updates, Hairdressers! 

As a quick reminder, we’d like to invite you to follow our game on Steam as well as wishlist us. If you want to keep up to date with the updates, check and follow our social media channels.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330560/Hairdresser_Simulator/

~Hairdresser Team
